title: Skribly status: incidents
description: The state of the public Skribly sites, checked on a schedule, with the incidents we write up by hand.

items.title: Rehearsal of the status page
items.summary: A drill that shows how an incident reads on this page. No service was affected.
items.content_html:
This is a rehearsal, not an incident. No Skribly service was affected. It shows how an incident reads here, and it is removed once the first real incident has been written up.

Timeline

  • 08:00 UTC, Investigating. What we saw: the symptom, and which sites it touches.
  • 08:20 UTC, Identified. What we found to be the cause.
  • 08:40 UTC, Monitoring. What we changed, and what we are watching.
  • 09:00 UTC, Resolved. The sites answer again. A short note on what happens next.

How an incident is written

An incident is one Markdown file per language under status/src/content/incidents/. The newest update goes at the bottom of the timeline and the summary says where things stand now.
